outputs.explanation: Panel A top is a bar chart showing mean±s.d. cell death percentages across conditions, but only error bars are shown; no individual data points from the three independent experiments are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B top is a bar chart of cell death percentage with error bars representing means, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel C is a grouped bar chart showing mean±s.d. of cell death (%) across time points and genotypes for three experiments, but individual data points are not shown.
Panel D top is a bar chart of cell death percentage with error bars, but no individual data points are overlaid to show the underlying replicate measurements.
